result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and content truncation issues, but nothing broken or blocking functionality.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel cuts off the third item (Trattoria Piccol...) mid-word and mid-image at the right edge, which can look unintentionally clipped rather than clearly scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial-peek offset or fade indicator so the truncated card reads clearly as a scrollable carousel, and ensure restaurant names don't cut off abruptly.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without a visible ellipsis styling consistency and its delivery info is also clipped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent text truncation with an ellipsis and adequate spacing so the label appears intentional.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the first 'Popular right now' ramen card appears with a white/outlined style while the second card below uses a dark filled circle, creating visual inconsistency between cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The '−100%' promo badge on the pizza card is ambiguous and could confuse users about the actual discount.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the badge label (e.g., 'Free' or a specific discount amount) to avoid confusion.
